# End-to-end semantic compile with LLM extraction and provenance

An end-to-end compile runs with a fake LLM provider to extract semantic entities, persist them to storage, and render wiki pages. Persisted entities include anchors from validated symbol paths and provenance records containing model_id and template_version.
